parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue by filtering constraints based on the type being deleted, but it may not handle all edge cases.

issues.description: The patch assumes that constraint names will contain 'uniq' or 'idx' which may not always be the case. This could lead to incorrect filtering of constraints.
The code could be more readable with comments explaining the logic of filtering constraints.
